long_biography.plain_text:
Şeref Yazıcı launched the Czech company that now operates as Spike Technology. Incorporated as Darkex Exchange, it was built around virtual-asset services, with Yazıcı as sole shareholder and manager. As the leadership group widened, he stepped away from day-to-day management and the shares moved for a period to a Dubai development company.

The business later took the Spike Technology name, and Yazıcı again became its sole shareholder. Its management includes Yılmaz Çağrı İşbuğa, a member of Darkex's technical founding team. Yazıcı now holds the ownership role without serving as a company manager, while İşbuğa continues in the executive structure.
